abstract: The sequential transplantation of embryonal carcinoma cells in vivo can accelerate the growth and malignancy of teratocarcinomas. However, the possible molecular mechanisms in this process that reflect cancer formation in the early stage are largely unknown and. To identify which genes are associated with the changes of malignancy of teratocarcinomas, we established a tumorigenesis model in which teratocarcinoma were induced via injecting embryonic stem cells into immuno-deficiency mice, isolating teratocarcinoma stem cell from a teratocarcinoma in serum-free culture medium and injecting teratocarcinoma stem cells into immune-deficient mice continuously. By using high-throughput deep sequence technology, we identified 26 differentially expressed genes related to the changes of characteristics of teratocarcinoma stem cell in which 18 out of 26 genes were down-regulated and 8 genes were up-regulated. Among these genes, several tumor-related genes such as Gata3, Arnt and Tdgf1, epigenetic associated genes such as PHC1 and Uty were identified. Pathway enrichment analysis result revealed that Wnt signaling pathway, primary immunodeficiency pathway, antigen processing and presentation pathway and allograft rejection pathway were involved in the teratocarcinoma tumorigenesis (corrected p value<0.05). In summary, our study established a tumorigenesis model and proposed some candidate genes and signaling pathways that may play a key role in the early stage of cancer occurrence.
abstract_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の逐次的な生体内移植は、奇形癌の増殖と悪性度を加速しうる。しかし、初期段階の癌形成を反映する、この過程における分子機構は大部分が不明である。奇形癌の悪性度の変化に関連する遺伝子を同定するため、胚性幹細胞を免疫不全マウスに注射して奇形癌を誘導し、奇形癌から無血清培養で奇形癌幹細胞を分離し、奇形癌幹細胞を継続的に免疫不全マウスに注射する腫瘍形成モデルを構築した。ハイスループット・ディープシーケンス技術を用いて、奇形癌幹細胞の特性変化に関連する26個の差次的発現遺伝子を同定した。そのうち18個は発現低下、8個は発現上昇していた。これらの遺伝子のうち、Gata3、Arnt、Tdgf1などの腫瘍関連遺伝子や、PHC1、Utyなどのエピジェネティック関連遺伝子が同定された。パスウェイ濃縮解析の結果、Wntシグナル伝達経路、原発性免疫不全経路、抗原提示経路、同種移植拒絶経路が奇形癌の腫瘍形成に関与していることが明らかになった(補正p値<0.05)。要約すると、本研究は腫瘍形成モデルを確立し、癌発生の初期段階で重要な役割を果たしうる候補遺伝子とシグナル伝達経路を提示した。
